Im an esthetician that isn't currently working so I've been buying products from Ulta for my skin to save money. I really like this mask. It brightens and softens my skin. avis.titre: If you need an effective pore mask, this is your sign!
avis.texte: This is where my comment starts to get long. As said by others, it does BURN. Though I didn't really mind because thats how I know its working, thank goodness! If you don't like your face burning for around 1-6 minutes I wouldn't recommend this product, but as I said, some pore masks don't burn and sometimes I can't tell if it's working or not. This one is! It smells pretty good, and a little really does go a long way. I've used this product for around a month now (on and off). It has shown amazing results and cleans my pores even when I have severe cases of acne. I use it on and off due to the burning (because my skin is sensitive; though the mask doesn't really affect my face too much). I recommend: - I recommend using this pore mask with a face mask. It calms the burning sensation and soothes your face at the same time. Love the duel effect. - I recommend this is friends and family, I get my acne from them and they deserve calmness with their pores. - Lastly, I recommend doing this every day depending on how many products you are using. I hope everyone who has made it this far has a splendid day, and bless them all < 3
